svg.title: SupplyIQ — end-to-end supply chain analytics platform architecture
svg.desc: Seven-layer pipeline: SAP synthetic sources feed Apache Airflow, which writes Parquet files to a data lake. dbt transforms bronze, silver, and gold layers into DuckDB. FastAPI serves 14 filtered endpoints paired with a Groq AI advisor, feeding a React dashboard.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the SAP MM synthetic data generator work?')
sendPrompt('How does the SAP SD synthetic data generator work?')
sendPrompt('How does the SAP WM/IM synthetic data generator work?')
sendPrompt('How are the two Airflow DAGs structured for this pipeline?')
g.text: DAG 01: daily ingestion · DAG 02: dbt transform · ExternalTaskSensor dependency

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What Parquet files does the daily trigger script generate?')
g.text: data/raw/mm · data/raw/sd · data/raw/wm · incremental daily append

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What do the bronze dbt models do?')
sendPrompt('What do the silver dbt models do?')
sendPrompt('What do the gold dbt models produce?')
sendPrompt('Why is DuckDB the right data warehouse for this project?')
g.text: OLAP warehouse · columnar · Parquet-native · zero config · free tier

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How is the FastAPI backend structured with filtered endpoints?')
sendPrompt('How does the Groq AI advisor answer questions from live gold layer data?')
sendPrompt('How is the React dashboard structured with 8 pages and backend filters?')
g.text: 8 pages · live filters · Recharts · Tailwind CSS · Vite
